title: spec.reinterpreted (v1)
description: ProblemModelingAgent's ReinterpretingSpec output (state machine V1.10 §1): having read the frozen ResearchSpec plus the literature / field-trajectory briefs, it has frozen a SpecInterpretation into the Research Store (see agents/problem_modeling_agent/data-contracts/spec_interpretation.schema.yaml) and, if the scope changed, a revised ResearchSpec. Payload is intentionally minimal: both artifacts are read from the Research Store by ref.

disposition.description: ProblemModelingAgent's verdict on the original ResearchSpec after reinterpretation, mirroring SpecInterpretation.disposition.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen SpecInterpretation object.

revised_research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the (possibly unchanged) ResearchSpec object.
